dreamer.how: a shy young clerk of twenty-six who has never talked to a woman: soft, a little breathless, eloquent when he hides in bookish phrases and speaks of himself in the third person, stumbling and quiet when he says something plain; self-mocking, tender, never loud

nastya.how: a girl of seventeen: quick, direct and a little bossy in a sweet way, laughs easily and cries easily, decides fast; when ashamed she talks faster and laughs; proud and hurt underneath

lodger.how: a poor, proud young man of about twenty-eight: upright, formal, measured, as if before his superiors; polite to the point of coldness when jealous; never says sorry

babushka.how: a blind old woman past seventy: querulous, suspicious and nosy, asks questions at cross-purposes, brightens when she remembers her youth; old, a little thin-voiced

matryona.how: an old servant woman past sixty: plain, flat, unhurried, a little grumbling; indifferent in the voice, sharp in the eyes; old-fashioned common speech

glasha.how: a pert housemaid with keys: brisk, chatty, offhand, common speech, says everything in passing

fyokla.how: a deaf old servant woman: loud, flat, puzzled

dvornik.how: a yardman with a broom: loud, guffawing, good-natured mockery, common speech

gentleman.how: a gentleman in a tailcoat, tipsy, cheeky and cowardly: slurring a little, suddenly polite when he sees a stick

passerby.how: a passer-by in a hurry: offhand, quick, polite by habit

nanny.how: a nurse-maid out with a child: calm, kindly, unhurried

yard_man.how: a man in the yard below: plain, busy

yard_woman.how: a woman in the yard below: plain, busy
